all_text_content:
Verse of the Day
Fear thou not; for I am with thee: be not dismayed; for I am thy God: I will strengthen thee; yea, I will help thee; yea, I will uphold thee with the right hand of my righteousness.
Isaiah 41:10
Quote of the Day
"The meek are models of self-control, using or withholding their considerable powers and gifts as is best in every situation."
President D. Todd Christofferson | 1 Apr 2026General Conference
